symptom: JSON config fails to parse paths like C:\new\tool
cause: Backslash starts JSON escape sequences (\n newline, \t tab).
solution: Double every backslash in JSON strings, or use forward slashes which Windows APIs accept.

symptom: Command fails on paths containing spaces
cause: Unquoted paths split into separate arguments.
solution: Quote every path with spaces; in Go prefer exec with arg slices over shell strings.

symptom: File not found for MAX_PATH-adjacent deep trees
cause: Classic 260-char MAX_PATH limit on legacy APIs.
solution: Enable long paths via group policy / manifest, or prefix with \\.\ for raw access.

symptom: Trailing backslash breaks quoted path (C:\dir\")
cause: The quote is escaped by the trailing backslash.
solution: Strip trailing separators before quoting, or double the trailing backslash.

symptom: %VAR% not expanding in a Go-launched process
cause: Go os.ExpandEnv uses $VAR syntax, not %VAR%.
solution: Normalize %VAR% to $VAR before ExpandEnv, or set env explicitly via cmd.Env.

symptom: PowerShell script blocked with execution policy error
cause: Default Restricted/AllSigned policy blocks unsigned scripts.
solution: Run with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass for one-shot commands; never lower the machine policy.

symptom: cmd.exe quoting behaves differently from PowerShell
cause: cmd uses " doubling rules; PowerShell has its own parser plus native-arg passing.
solution: Invoke binaries directly with arg slices (exec.Command). Avoid shell round-trips.

symptom: Case-only file renames ignored by git on Windows
cause: NTFS is case-insensitive; git sees no change.
solution: Use git mv with an intermediate name, or set core.ignorecase=false after renaming.
cmd: git mv Foo tmp && git mv tmp foo

symptom: Temp files land in unexpected per-user cache dirs
cause: os.CreateTemp uses %TEMP% which roams per user and session.
solution: Pass explicit -t dirs for test tempfiles (t.TempDir in Go) and clean deferred.

symptom: UNC path (\\server\share) rejected by a tool
cause: Some tools require drive letters or mishandle double leading slashes.
solution: Map with net use to a drive letter for the session, or normalize to forward slashes.

symptom: Drive-letter case mismatch breaks string path compares
cause: C:\ vs c:\ compare unequal as strings.
solution: Normalize with filepath.Clean plus case-fold on the drive prefix before comparing.

symptom: filepath.Join produces separators a JSON consumer rejects
cause: Backslashes need escaping in JSON payloads.
solution: Convert to slash form with filepath.ToSlash before embedding in JSON.

symptom: EADDRINUSE on restart (port still held)
cause: Previous process alive, or socket stuck in TIME_WAIT.
solution: Find the PID and kill it, or wait out TIME_WAIT; never hard-code a new port to dodge it.

symptom: Bind fails on 20128/8000 right after boot
cause: Windows excluded port ranges (Hyper-V / NAT) swallow the port.
solution: Check netsh int ipv4 show excludedportrange; pick a port outside exclusions or free one.
cmd: netsh int ipv4 show excludedportrange protocol=tcp

symptom: Server reachable on 127.0.0.1 but not localhost
cause: localhost resolves to ::1 while the server bound IPv4 only (or reverse).
solution: Bind dual-stack or normalize to 127.0.0.1 explicitly on both ends.

symptom: Firewall prompt blocks first run of a dev server
cause: Windows Defender Firewall intercepts new listeners.
solution: Bind 127.0.0.1 during development to avoid the prompt; document the rule for LAN testing.

symptom: SO_REUSEADDR still reports address in use
cause: A live listener (not TIME_WAIT) owns the port; reuse only helps TIME_WAIT.
solution: Kill the owner process; reuse flags never evict a live listener.

symptom: Port works locally, refused from another machine
cause: Bound to loopback instead of 0.0.0.0, or firewall rule missing.
solution: Bind 0.0.0.0 for LAN exposure and add an explicit inbound firewall rule.

symptom: Two dev servers collide on the same default port
cause: Both configs share one default with no override.
solution: Make the port a flag/env with a documented default; fail fast with the owner PID.

symptom: Ephemeral client ports exhausted under load tests
cause: Thousands of short connections in TIME_WAIT drain the dynamic range.
solution: Reuse connections (keep-alive/pools) instead of dialing per request.

symptom: Diff shows every line changed after a Windows edit
cause: CRLF vs LF line-ending flip across the whole file.
solution: Enforce .gitattributes text=auto plus editorconfig end_of_line, then renormalize once.

symptom: JSON parser chokes on a file that looks valid
cause: UTF-8 BOM prefix is illegal in strict JSON.
solution: Save JSON as UTF-8 without BOM; strip a leading BOM on read.

symptom: Go vet/gofmt churn on files edited on Windows
cause: CRLF line endings in Go sources.
solution: Keep Go sources LF-only via .gitattributes (*.go text eol=lf).

symptom: PowerShell mangles UTF-8 CLI output (mojibake)
cause: Console code page is legacy (437/1252), not UTF-8.
solution: Switch with chcp 65001 for the session and prefer -NoProfile UTF-8 pipelines.

symptom: Checksums differ for identical-looking files
cause: Line-ending or BOM bytes differ under the hood.
solution: Compare canonicalized bytes (normalize CRLF, strip BOM) before hashing.

symptom: git shows-modified on untouched files after clone
cause: core.autocrlf converting on checkout against repo LF.
solution: Set core.autocrlf=input on Windows with text=auto attributes, re-checkout once.

symptom: Emoji/unicode corrupted in terminal output files
cause: Redirection through a non-UTF-8 code page.
solution: Write files from the process (UTF-8) instead of shell redirection.

symptom: Markdown renders stray characters at file start
cause: Invisible BOM or zero-width characters.
solution: Open as hex, strip leading EF BB BF, save clean UTF-8.

symptom: Python reads config with trailing \r characters
cause: File opened in binary or newline='' mode on CRLF content.
solution: Open text with universal newlines (default) or newline=None explicitly.

symptom: Cross-platform test golden files mismatch
cause: Goldens recorded with platform-native endings.
solution: Normalize both sides to LF before comparing in tests.

symptom: pip installs land globally instead of the project env
cause: venv not activated in that shell session.
solution: Activate per shell (.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1) or always use venv\Scripts\python -m pip.

symptom: Scripts/ vs bin/ activate confusion across OS
cause: Windows venvs use Scripts\, POSIX uses bin/.
solution: Branch activation paths per OS in docs and scripts; never hard-code one.

symptom: IDE runs the wrong interpreter despite a venv
cause: Editor defaulted to global Python.
solution: Pin the interpreter to the venv python explicitly in workspace settings.

symptom: Works on my machine but not in CI
cause: Unpinned transitive deps drift between installs.
solution: Commit pip freeze output as requirements.lock and install with --no-deps drift checks.

symptom: System packages leak into the venv
cause: venv created with --system-site-packages.
solution: Recreate without the flag; vendor the few needed packages explicitly.

symptom: conda and venv fight over PATH
cause: Both shims prepend PATH; first match wins unpredictably.
solution: Pick one env manager per project and deactivate the other in that shell.

symptom: which python points at Store shim, not the venv
cause: PATH order puts the app-execution alias first.
solution: Invoke the venv python by absolute path in scripts and tasks.

symptom: pip cache serves stale wheels offline
cause: Cache hit on an outdated wheel version.
solution: Bust with --no-cache-dir for release builds; keep cache for dev speed.

symptom: Build uses stale dependency code after go get
cause: Module cache holds the old version; flags pin mod=readonly.
solution: Run go mod tidy and rebuild; clear GOMODCACHE only as a last resort.

symptom: import cycle not allowed in test build
cause: Circular package imports (often via test helpers).
solution: Extract the shared surface into a third package both sides import.

symptom: Vendor directory ignored, network hit on every build
cause: No vendor/ dir or -mod=mod overriding vendoring.
solution: Commit go mod vendor output and build with -mod=vendor for hermetic builds.

symptom: Checksum mismatch (GOSUMDB) on corporate proxy
cause: Proxy rewrites break sumdb verification.
solution: Point GOPROXY at the corporate proxy and set GONOSUMDB/GOSUMDB=off per policy.

symptom: Nested go.mod files confuse tooling
cause: Accidental module roots inside subdirectories.
solution: One module root per repo; delete stray go.mod files or split into workspaces.

symptom: Tests pass stale: caching hides a regression
cause: Go test caching replays old green results.
solution: Rerun with -count=1 for verification runs; keep cache for iteration.

symptom: replace directive pins a local fork forever
cause: Temporary replace left in go.mod after the fix.
solution: Remove replace lines before release; CI should fail on stray replaces.

symptom: Minimal version selection picks an ancient dep
cause: MVS honors the oldest allowed version in the graph.
solution: Bump the direct requirement explicitly with go get pkg@version.

symptom: go vet passes but build tags exclude test files
cause: Files gated behind //go:build tags compiled out.
solution: Vet with -tags for each target platform in CI.

symptom: Module cache grows unbounded on shared runners
cause: Every version ever fetched is retained.
solution: Schedule go clean -modcache on runner recycle, never mid-pipeline.

symptom: CI installs different tree than local
cause: package.json without lockfile, or lockfile ignored.
solution: Commit the lockfile and install with npm ci in CI.

symptom: ERESOLVE peer dependency conflict blocks install
cause: Two packages demand incompatible peers.
solution: Align versions first; use --legacy-peer-deps only as a documented last resort.

symptom: npx runs a stale global instead of local binary
cause: Global bin shadows node_modules/.bin on PATH.
solution: Call node_modules/.bin directly or npx --no-install to force local.

symptom: Postinstall scripts execute unreviewed code
cause: Lifecycle scripts run with user privileges on install.
solution: Audit new deps, set ignore-scripts for untrusted ones, review diffs.

symptom: Node version mismatch breaks native modules
cause: ABI differs across majors; bindings compiled for another.
solution: Pin engines in package.json and rebuild after switching versions.

symptom: Disk bloat from duplicated nested node_modules
cause: Hoisting conflicts force nested copies.
solution: Dedupe regularly; prefer workspaces over deep nesting.

symptom: audit reports unactionable noise on every install
cause: Dev-only advisory paths flagged in production surface.
solution: Audit production deps only and triage by exploitability, not count.

symptom: Workspace package resolves to published copy, not local
cause: Version bumps publish over the workspace link.
solution: Reference workspaces by name with workspace: protocol or file: links.

symptom: Lost work after a risky rebase
cause: No checkpoint commit or stash before rewriting.
solution: Create git stash create or a checkpoint tag before every rewrite.

symptom: Shallow clone cannot describe or bisect
cause: --depth 1 omits the history those commands need.
solution: Deepen with git fetch --unshallow when history operations are required.

symptom: LFS files checkout as pointer stubs
cause: LFS smudge filter missing or skipped.
solution: Install git-lfs and pull LFS objects explicitly once.

symptom: CRLF flip-flop in every PR from mixed OS contributors
cause: No .gitattributes policy; each OS converts differently.
solution: Commit text=auto with explicit eol rules per extension, renormalize once.
